parts.name: T1 late (m 2), unscaled reader: mean (E_u - E_u(twin)) <= -0.05
T2 late (m 2), scaled reader: mean (E_cg - E_u(twin)) >= -0.06
T2 late (m 2), scaled reader: mean (E_cg - E_u(twin)) <= 0.09
T3 late (m 2), the same records: mean (E_cg - E_u) >= 0.10
T5 late (m 2), the twins: mean (E_cg(twin) - E_u(twin)) >= 0
T6 prompt (m 0), scaled reader: mean (E_cg - E_u(twin)) >= -0.1
T6 prompt (m 0), scaled reader: mean (E_cg - E_u(twin)) <= 0.1
T7 prompt (m 0), x2 < 1, unscaled reader: mean (E_u - E_u(twin)) <= -0.05
T7 prompt (m 0), x2 < 1, scaled reader: mean (E_cg - E_u(twin)) >= -0.05
T8 late (m 2), unscaled reader: mean ((E_u - gen_u) - (E_u - gen_u)(twin)) <= -0.05

statements.claim: doubling every declared length lowers the late signal's reconstruction under the unscaled reader (SM001's S4 on fresh blocks)
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the 27 refined conditions with the signal at 2 T* (m 2), the mean of E_u less E_u of the twin is <= -0.05, else FAILS

statements.claim: with the reader scaled with the lengths, at most 0.06 of the late loss remains
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of E_cg less E_u of the twin lies within [-0.06, 0.09], else FAILS

statements.claim: on the same records, the scaled reader recovers the late loss
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of E_cg less E_u is >= 0.10, else FAILS

statements.claim: the scaled reader's gain is specific to the doubled lengths
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of (E_cg - E_u) less the twin's (E_cg - E_u) is >= 0.04, else FAILS

statements.claim: a reader at twice the grain also reads the half-scale tissue better (the control)
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the twins of the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of E_cg less E_u is >= 0, else FAILS

statements.claim: under the prompt signal, the doubled lengths read with the scaled reader as the twin reads with the unscaled one
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the 54 refined conditions with m 0, the mean of E_cg less E_u of the twin lies within [-0.1, 0.1], else FAILS

statements.claim: where the patch is smaller than the coupling length, the unscaled reader loses even under the prompt signal, and the scaled reader loses at most 0.05
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 0 and L / lam_rest < 1, the mean of E_u less E_u of the twin is <= -0.05 and the mean of E_cg less E_u of the twin is >= -0.05, else FAILS

statements.claim: the unscaled reader's late loss is a loss of the acquired phase (SM001's P42d on fresh blocks)
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of (E_u - gen_u) less the twin's (E_u - gen_u) is <= -0.05, else FAILS
